author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.52 shipped: Night lights red on return at sleep; plain-English room sensors form
summary: Night lights red on return at sleep; plain-English room sensors form
why: The red-at-sleep night-light decision lived only in the canonical turn-on path, so a light returning from offline or corrected by the reconciler during sleep came back in the normal colour; moving the decision into the shared resolver makes every path agree. The room sensors form used internal wording and showed a raw JSON field to every operator, which confuses less technical users onboarding new houses; plain labels plus Advanced-only JSON fixes that.
implications: Shipped NIGHTLIGHT-RED-RECONCILE-PARITY-1, SENSOR-FORM-PLAIN-TEXT-1 at v5.103.52; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.52.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a sleep-time night light returns non-red, or operators still misfile sensors after reading the new form.
